ward_absorb.name: Ward Absorb

patient_ward.name: Patient Ward
patient_ward.description: The Healing Ward costs a quarter less to hold.

lasting_mending.name: Lasting Mending
lasting_mending.description: Mending (the spell) lasts half as long again.

respite.name: Respite
respite.description: Half of what you heal comes back as Stamina too.

battle_medic.name: Battle Medic
battle_medic.description: With an enemy within 10 m, healing is 25% stronger.

desperate_prayer.name: Desperate Prayer
desperate_prayer.description: Under a quarter of your health, healing is half as strong again.

cleansing_light.name: Cleansing Light
cleansing_light.description: Healing (and casting Mending) ends poison, bleeding, burning and venom.

shared_light.name: Shared Light
shared_light.description: Healing reaches your companion within 6 m too.

last_breath.name: Last Breath
last_breath.description: Once every ten minutes, falling under a tenth of your health heals you 50.

master_illusionist.name: Master Illusionist
master_illusionist.description: Glamour spells are 25% stronger and 25% cheaper.

dreadful.name: Dreadful
dreadful.description: Fear lasts half as long again.

panic.name: Panic
panic.description: An enemy fleeing in fear takes 25% more from you.

terror.name: Terror
terror.description: Fear lasts half as long again.

beguiling.name: Beguiling
beguiling.description: Charm lasts half as long again.

enthrall.name: Enthrall
enthrall.description: Charm lasts half as long again.

blood_frenzy.name: Blood Frenzy
blood_frenzy.description: Frenzy lasts half as long again.

many_faces.name: Many Faces
many_faces.description: Mirror Image lasts half as long again.

lasting_phantoms.name: Lasting Phantoms
lasting_phantoms.description: Mirror Image lasts half as long again.

lasting_veil.name: Lasting Veil
lasting_veil.description: Invisibility lasts half as long again.

shades_edge.name: Shade's Edge
shades_edge.description: Your blows from Invisibility do half as much again.

honeyed_words.name: Honeyed Words
honeyed_words.description: +10 to persuade, intimidate and bribe checks.

master_of_tides.name: Master of Tides
master_of_tides.description: Tidecraft spells half as strong again.

tide_caller.name: Tide-Caller
tide_caller.description: Tidecraft spells charge another 30% faster and cost 20% less.

undertow.name: Undertow
undertow.description: Pull is half as strong again.

breaker.name: Breaker
breaker.description: Tide's Shove is half as strong again.

deep_well.name: Deep Well
deep_well.description: Gravity Well is half as strong again.

crushing_depths.name: Crushing Depths
crushing_depths.description: Moon-Crush is half as strong again.

rising_tide.name: Rising Tide
rising_tide.description: The Lifting Tide is half as strong again.

moon_touched.name: Moon-Touched
moon_touched.description: The moons sway your Tidecraft twice as much, both ways.

steady_tide.name: Steady Tide
steady_tide.description: The moons never weaken your Tidecraft.

moonborn.name: Moonborn
moonborn.description: At a high tide, every spell you cast is 20% stronger.
